disabled_metadata.radio_quality_domain_description: Deterministic union grid of per-cell effective-radius disks; fixed before azimuth scoring and sampled, not a continuous-area integral
disabled_metadata.interference_horizon_description: finite per-cell interference-analysis horizon; outside_radius means the point is beyond that cell's configured radius and is not physical zero RF power or a receiver-sensitivity result
disabled_metadata.radio_quality_serviceability_rule: serviceable = RSRP >= threshold AND SINR >= threshold AND RSRQ >= threshold
disabled_metadata.radio_quality_co_channel_eligibility_rul: exact channel_id, frequency_ghz, bandwidth_mhz, and technology match
